title: 19 years as a banker. At 49, she quit to sell lipstick online. October 26, 2026.
excerpt: From a journalist who died trying to stop a riot, to a scientist who followed her father into one of the world's oldest academies, to Canadian radio stations raising 2 million dollars for Punjab flood relief in two days, to India's solar capacity passing a historic milestone, to a banker who walked away from two decades of security at 49 - October 26's five stories are about what people choose to build when they could have just stayed where they were.
bodyHtml:
Every story today is a choice to leave something secure behind - a safe silence instead of a dangerous rescue, a comfortable research career instead of public scrutiny, a quiet evening instead of two days on the phone lines, fossil-fuel dependence instead of a harder build-out, and a stable finance career instead of starting over at 49.

October 26, 1890: a journalist was born who gave Bhagat Singh his first writing job - and died trying to stop a riot

Ganesh Shankar Vidyarthi, born in Allahabad, founded the Hindi newspaper Pratap in 1913 and was jailed five times under British rule. He was killed in 1931 trying to rescue people trapped in Kanpur's communal riots.

Only one Indian woman had ever been elected a Fellow of the Royal Society. In 2026, a second one joined her

Dr. Soumya Swaminathan, former WHO Chief Scientist, was elected a Fellow of the Royal Society in May 2026 - becoming only the second Indian woman ever elected, and joining her late father M.S. Swaminathan as part of what's reported as India's first father-daughter FRS pair.

Punjab flooded. Canadian radio stations raised 2 million dollars for it in 2 days

When floods hit over 1,400 villages across Punjab in September 2025, the Red FM radio network ran emergency radiothons across Surrey, Calgary and Toronto, raising roughly $2 million CAD in two days - routed through a Surrey-based nonprofit with on-ground presence in India.

India just crossed 164 gigawatts of solar power

India's installed solar capacity crossed 164.59 GW by July 2026, making it the world's third-largest solar market - a nearly 57-fold increase since 2014.

19 years as an investment banker. At 49, she quit to sell lipstick online

Falguni Nayar spent nearly two decades at Kotak Mahindra before leaving at 49 to start Nykaa, a beauty e-commerce company, with no prior experience in the industry. Nykaa went public in 2021, making her India's wealthiest self-made woman.

Five stories, one pattern: a journalist who chose danger over silence, a scientist who chose scrutiny over comfort, a diaspora that chose two days on the phones over looking away, a country that chose a harder energy build-out, and a banker who chose to start over at an age most people call it settled.
